1041Transport services

Railhead

rachittshah/railhead

Play the transport game OpenTTD as one company to deliver cargo, repair a faulty truck route, abstain from impossible contracts or grow net worth.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • long-horizon game agents
  • verifiable replay rewards

Reward

How it is scored
State check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

The verifier replays the agent's action log from a sealed start state and computes family-specific rewards such as min(1, D/Q) for deliveries.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

harbor run -p <task_dir> -a <agent> -m <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download rachittshah/railhead --repo-type dataset --local-dir railhead

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/rachittshah/railhead --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Docker image ghcr.io/rachittshah/railhead:0.1.0.

Evidence

Oracle and idle reward certificates ship with each task.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
